> Locally owned cash home buying company headquartered in San Antonio, Texas. We purchase residential properties across Bexar, Comal, Guadalupe, Kendall, Wilson, and Atascosa counties for cash, in any condition, with no fees and no commissions. Closings happen at Texas title companies in 7-30 days.

## Situation pages

- [Stop foreclosure](https://sacashhomebuyers.co/foreclosure): Texas is a non-judicial foreclosure state under Tex. Prop. Code § 51.002. Lenders can post a Notice of Trustee Sale and complete the sale in as little as 21 days. No statutory right of redemption after sale for residential property.
- [Inherited house / probate](https://sacashhomebuyers.co/inherited): Texas independent administration is one of the fastest probate processes in the country. Letters Testamentary typically issue in 30-60 days. Small Estate Affidavit available under Tex. Estates Code Ch. 205 for estates under $75,000 personal property. Affidavit of Heirship available for properties where owner died 4+ years ago.
- [Divorce sale](https://sacashhomebuyers.co/divorce): Texas is a community property state under Tex. Fam. Code § 3.001-3.003. Real property acquired during marriage is presumed community. Both spouses must sign to convey. 60-day waiting period after filing petition.
- [Sell as-is](https://sacashhomebuyers.co/as-is): Foundation issues on expansive clay soils, post-tension slab failures, fire/hail damage, hoarder situations, code violations, Hill Country septic/well issues.

## Important Texas legal context

- **Foreclosure**: Texas is a non-judicial foreclosure state. Most residential deeds of trust authorize a trustee sale without court involvement. Notice of Trustee Sale must be (1) recorded with the county clerk, (2) posted at the courthouse door, and (3) mailed to the debtor at least 21 days before the first Tuesday of the sale month (Tex. Prop. Code § 51.002). Sales occur on the first Tuesday of each month, 10am-4pm. No statutory right of redemption for residential property post-sale.
- **Community property**: Texas is one of nine US community property states. All property acquired by either spouse during marriage is presumed community (Tex. Fam. Code § 3.003). Both spouses must execute the deed to convey community real property. Separate property (pre-marriage, gift, inheritance) has different rules.
- **Homestead protections**: Texas has the strongest homestead protections in the country (Tex. Const. Art. XVI § 50-52). If the property is the homestead and seller is married, both spouses must sign to convey — even if only one is on the deed and even if the property is the separate property of one spouse. The homestead is also protected from most non-mortgage creditor judgments.
- **Probate**: Texas Estates Code allows independent administration — one of the fastest probate processes nationally. Letters Testamentary typically issue in 30-60 days. Small Estate Affidavit available under Ch. 205 for estates under $75,000 non-real-estate personal property. Affidavit of Heirship available for older deaths where probate was never opened.
- **Disclosure**: Texas requires a Seller's Disclosure Notice under Tex. Prop. Code § 5.008 for most residential resales. Some exemptions apply (foreclosure, probate, transfer to/from trust, etc.). As-is sales still typically require disclosure of known defects.
- **Title**: Texas title insurance is heavily regulated by the Texas Department of Insurance. All title insurance premiums are set by TDI — no rate competition between title companies on price.
- **Transfer**: Texas has no state real estate transfer tax. Recording fees minimal.

## Pricing approach

Our cash offers follow a standard formula: after-repair market value (based on neighborhood-specific comparable sales) minus estimated repair budget minus our holding and transaction costs equals the cash offer. We commit to the offer in writing and do not renegotiate at closing. Our offers are typically below full retail; we are most competitive when sellers prioritize speed, certainty, or have properties that would not qualify for conventional financing.
